batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b PP Chawla

batting.dismissal: c Y Nagar b IK Pathan

batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b M Morkel

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b AB Agarkar

batting.dismissal: c JR Hopes b AB Agarkar

balls.text: ends with a low full toss on legstump, rao can't get it away, the ball dribbles to the leg side, Delhi finish on a massive 231 the third highest score in IPL history
length ball is drilled towards long-on for a single
length ball outside off, Ojha gets into the act now, smashes it over cover for six more, 20 off the over so far
good response from Harris, a yorker, which Rao can just about keep out
Rao on fire here, a short ball on legstump, Rao stands tall and pulls that authoritatively to square leg for four
Harris looks to chase the batsman who is making room, too far down the leg, and that's some free runs for Delhi
Delhi piling on the runs, a length ball spearing down leg, Rao slams it to midwicket for four

once again the over ends with a six, gets the front leg out of the way and looks to power the ball towards extra cover, a ball of an edge bu there is still enough on that to sail over the point boundary
bowler pushes the ball wide as he sees the batsman making room, batsman has to lean across to reach, get it towards deep point
another bouncer, once more batsman makes no contact
beautiful hit from Venu, makes room and carves it over extra cover for a boundary that brings up the first 200 of the season
Ojha again aims a swipe to midwicket, takes a blow on his ribs as he can't get hold of the ball
slow bouncer there, batsman was too early to make contact
Sehwag and Warner may have hit some big shots, but nothing can top this brilliant hit from Venugopal Rao, a length ball on offstump is sent rocketing straight back, into the second tier
batsman was backing away to a full ball outside off, bottom-edge to the keeper
short of length ball on off, Rao brings out an agricultural swipe towards square leg
jags in sharply, Ojha is startled by that, dabbed towards point
lovely touch from Ojha, skips towards leg and opens the face to get a faint tickle past the keeper for four, Gilchrist puts in the dive but in vain
superb start to the over, short of length and in the channel, Ojha is beaten outside off

and another Delhi wicket goes, Agarkar will have to bowl well now, Finch makes plenty of room to play it inside out, gets too much under that one from Chawla, balloons to Karthik at sweeper cover, and Delhi's fast losing momentum here, can they at least get to 200?
overpitched on middle and leg, whipped towards wide mid-on
straighter one just outside off, poked towards short third man
Rao gets well forward and tucks the ball towards square leg
drilled down towards long-on for a single
Finch looks to tuck the ball to the leg side, hit on the pad outside off
Finch wanted to play his first ball towards midwicket, gets a leading edge back towards the bowler

Punjab pulling things back here, Warner is gone as he again gets on one knee and looks to clear long-on as he has so often today, this time he can't get it past Ryan Harris, who is lurking in the deep once more, end of Warner's innings
length ball on offstump, worked behind point

length ball outside off, powered off the backfoot towards past extra cover, where a diving in the deep keeps the batsmen to three, David Hussey it was who did the fielding, which gets some applause form Praveen
length ball on offstump, worked off the back foot to the right of the bowler for a single
worked towards short third for a single
guides the final ball of the over towards point
just as I say Delhi are being kept quiet, Warner unleashes perhaps the biggest six of the day, get down on one knee and bludgeons the ball over wide long-on
Chawla is keeping Delhi quiet here, length ball on legstump, blocked off the back foot
swept towards short fine leg for a single to get off the mark
slashed towards deep point for a single
driven off the front foot towards extra cover
Nagar smashes that it, hard and flat, but doesn't have the distance, it flies straight to Harris at long-off, who fluffs it on the first attempts but catches it on the rebound
length ball on legstump, for some reason Warner decides to play that to the off side instead of swinging it over leg, he gets a single to cover
fullish ball is worked towards extra cover for a single
Nayar bowling terrible deliveries here, that was a full toss just outside off, Nagar swings his arms and sends that into the crowd beyond long-on
Nagar is underway, width on offer and he slashes that past point for four
Nayar bowls it full and wide, punched towards extra cover
that ends a superb over from Srivastava, Nagar looks to power the ball through off but it sneaks under his bat
no swipe from Nagar, short of length and outside off, stabbed towards short third man
this was a short one and just outside off, no shot offered  by Nagar, expect a big swipe next ball
Nagar drops his wrist and lets it go as the ball angles across him from a short of a length
jags in from a short of a length to cramp Nagar who wanted to guide that to third man
full and into the pads, Warner whips it towards mid-on, a direct hit at the stumps, and Delhi take the overthrow that takes them to 150
length ball outside off, played with soft hands towards cover by Warner, some sloppy work from the Punjab fielder allows a second
no need to guess what Nagar has been sent up the order, he looks to pummel the first ball to square leg but doesn't connect
Warner gets a single towards long-on

relief for Punjab, the Delhi crowd is silenced, Sehwag goes for his fourth six in a row but can't latch on to the ball as well as he would have liked, a bit of an inside-edge and that is taken smartly by Karthik at deep midwicket
make that three in a row, at this rate, Punjab will need more than Agarkar's largesse to win this game, this time over deep square leg, Sehwag in an everything-must-go mode here
another six, Punjab are clueless, Kotla crowd goes bonkers, gets his front leg out of the way and swats that over midwicket for six
Hussey's first ball of the season is clobbered over long-on by Sehwag for six, fasten your seat belts, folks, carnage ahead
a slow full toss to end the over, inside-edged onto the pads, Sehwag doesn't know where the ball is after it cannons off the pads, it's behind his leg, Warner calls him through for a single
smashed off the front foot through extra cover
nothing working for Punjab, Sehwag gets a top edge as he pulls the ball, gets the top-edge and the fielder at deep square leg was interested but it just about clears him and the rope

short ball rises sharply on Sehwag, an ungainly nurdle as  he gets the ball away from shoulder height, Sehwag has to dive to make his ground as he comes back for the second, and that's his first half-century of the season, Sid Monga points out another first, first dive he's seen Sehwag dive to make his ground
short and wide, Warner lashes the ball towards deep point for a single
lovely from Sehwag, lifts his front leg as he glances the ball down towards fine leg
Warner moves beyond leg and looks to guide the  ball past the keeper towards short third man but can't connect
on the pads, nudged towards midwicket for a single
Chawla continues to get stick, a length ball on offstump, Sehwag makes a bit of room and launches that over extra cover for four, he's closing in on his half-century now
on middle stump, guided down to fine leg
again on the leg stump, worked to midwicket
Sehwag also shows his soft side, a full ball pitching outside leg beautiful use of the wrist, throw in some terrific timing and that ball is speeding away to the square leg boundary
Sehwag waits for a long time for Valthaty's medium-paced delivery to reach, punches it off the back foot for a single
pushed off the back foot towards the off side for a single
the hundred stand comes up as Warner finesses the ball behind backward point for a four, nicely done
slapped to backward point
short from Valthaty, Warner hammers that over midwicket, sails into the crowd and thats not a bad way to bring up the half-century
his first ball is driven to long-on by Sehwag
quicker ball to end the over, on offstump, blocked off the backfoot
flicks it off the pads towards midwicket for a quick two
another single, this time to sweeper cover from Sehwag
not a good start from Chawla, another boundary, to midwicket, a horribly short ball from Chawla
a single is taken to sweeper cover
first ball of spin, short from Chawla, smashed to the square leg boundary for four by Warner
power from Warner, just short he leans back and flat bats it past mid-on, a diving fielder at mid-on gets a hand on it but still the ball races on towards the rope, where it is fielded
length ball on legstump, worked to the leg side for a single
short and wide, pummelled towards cover
back of a length, just down the leg side, helped along to the fine leg boundary
Sehwag looks to whip the ball to the leg side, doesn't time it
Nayar starts with a length ball outside off, driven past extra cover

tucked behind square leg for a single, Punjab call for the break, which Nitin Sundar wants to be known as the Statsguru time-out. The stat is: Gilchrist has hit most sixes in both Test cricket and in IPL
not as convincing from Warner this time, the ball moves away from him as he looks to cut, it is on to him quicker than he expected and the ball flies off the top edge past slip
take that! a length ball is cleanly hit by Warner, goes over the bowler's head and over the sight screen as well, Warner shows he has plenty of power
Sehwag stands tall, punches the ball towards point and scrambles a single
big movement for Srivastava, unfortunately for him that starts on leg and swings a long way down, that was 138kmh

Srivastava has Warner in a bit of trouble, the ball cannons off Warner's pads towards the leg side, stifled appeal from the bowler for lbw, Warner is racing out of his crease, before scrambling back and diving to make his ground
back of a length, pushed off the back foot towards extra cover
width from Praveen, thanks say Sehwag and slashes that powerfully past point for four to bring up Delhi's 50, not a bad start at all after being sent in
full and on offstump, driven to mid-off for a quick single, there is a direct hit but Warner is easily home
just outside off, played towards short third man
full and on the pads, whipped towards deep midwicket where Ryan Harris has plenty of ground to make before he can cut it off
another wide, down the leg side
much better from Sehwag, cut in from Praveen, Sehwag again wants to play it to leg, edged down to third man, this hasn't been Sehwag at his best
Praveen's poor day continues, a full toss to start the over, all too easy for Sehwag, who doesn't move his feet, just a swing of the bat to send the ball over the bowler's head
Bang! as Shastri would say, a shortish ball outside off, Warner stays in the creases, leans back and muscles it over midwicket for six, first of the day
punched by Warner off the back foot towards cover
and again Sehwag survives and awkward shot, he was looking to work that to the leg side, gets the edge past slip and down to third man
Harris troubling Sehwag here, Sehwag is cut in half by a ball that snakes in after bouncing
a bit of width, Warner loves it there, a muscular cut sends the ball flying to deep point, taken on the bounce by the fielder there
quick incutter from Harris, did that hit him on the glove as he looked to guide that to cover, Sehwag's doesn't wring his hand or show other signs of discomfort, perhaps the ball hit the handle
Praveen is having trouble with his line today, once more slips it past leg
that one jagged in sharply from off stump line, Sehwag looks to whip it to the leg stump but it is off his pads
Sehwag's in top gear now, he's been given width, never a good idea, he latches on to that one, and powers it over point for four
much better stroke from Sehwag, both feet off the air as he clips a legstump delivery through midwicket, no power behind that shot but it fetched him a boundary

Sehwag gets off the mark, but not too convincingly, he wants to launch that over extra cover off the front foot, doesn't time it at all, Piyush Chawla runs after it in the hope of getting under that lofted shot, it too far for him
overpitched on middle and off, Sehwag gets forward and defends towards cover
and again Harris gets the ball to rise rapidly, Warner looks to fend that, gets the outside edge which flies well wide of first slip and to the third man boundary
plenty of bounce on offer there, steepler from Harris, Warner was looking to pull from outside off, but opts out of the shot at the last moment seeing how the ball climbed
another good shot from Warner, again he can't beat the field, this time extra cover is in the way
angling across Warner, who can't get bat on it
shortish and a bit of width, powered by Warner off the back foot but can't beat cover
first ball from Harris is defended to the leg side

Praveen has his hands on his head after he beats Sehwag with a ball that jags away after pitching on off, Sehwag looks to drive and can't get bat on ball, that's more of what Gilchrist wants from Praveen on this green track
the crowd finds its voice with Sehwag on strike., a short of length ball is defended off the front foot
full and on the legstump, Warner leans across and tucks the ball to deep square leg, the fielder at the boundary slips but manages to stop the ball
slower ball from Praveen sits up for Warner, 108kmh, Warner gets back and cracks it past extra cover for four more, not the finest of starts from Praveen
thats power from Warner, a touch short and on legstump, Warner hammers that past a diving deep backward square leg for four
way down the leg side
first ball comes in to Warner, who defends it to the leg side
Nayar was backing away, Ajit chases him with a full ball outside leg, edged towards point, and that's victory for Delhi, they take this one by 29 runs, 433 runs in this match, the mind reels
attempts the reverse-scoop to a shortish ball from Ajit, doesn't connect too well
we have seen plenty of shots today, can't remember a reverse-sweep though, Nayar pulls off the first one, over backward point for four
in the blockhole, edge to the leg side by Harris
poked towards point, Nayar gets a single
one more for the Ajit, a fullish ball that Sunny Singh tried to blast over long-on, the safe hands of James Hopes latch on to it
that's a boundary to finish Aaron's contribution for the day, full and well outside off, carved past a diving extra cover for four more
overpitched ball on middle, lashed to long-on for a single
bowled from wide of the crease, shortish ball, Nayar looks to club it to midwicket, mistimed by him
144.2 kmh, full and wide, carved towards mid-off, straight at the fielder
147.6 kmh, fastest ball of the day from Aaron, a low full toss on leg stump that is crunched toward deep midwicket
Aaron's final over starts with a length ball that is whipped to mid-on
short of length ball outside leg, looks to pull that but doesn't connect
Nayar gets it right third time round, jumps across the stumps and paddles the ball past short fine for four

no century for Marsh, it ends on 95, outstanding effort from him, a length ball from Morkel on off, Marsh looks to cream it over midwicket, ends up slicing it straight up in the air, loops towards Sehwag at mid-off, thats the end of Punjab's challenge
six more, Marsh doesn't know the meaning of giving up, a full ball is lashed over wide mid-on for six more, just clears the rope
Marsh looking to hammer every ball, again he can't get hold of this one and it goes only as far as mid-on
Morkel's final over starts with a short of length ball outside off, mistimed flat batted hit towards mid-on by Marsh
Agarkar finishes with a good delivery, a full one on legstump, whipped towards midwicket for a single
Agarkar keeps giving length hit-me balls, Nayar gets too much under it, the ball balloons in the air and lands safely wide of Warner at mid-off
full toss on the pads, Marsh misses out, edged towards midwicket
make that 85, he is presented another length ball that is blasted over extra cover for four more, can Marsh become the first batsman to make two centuries in IPL?
brutality from Marsh, Agarkar gifts it on a length on offstump, thumped over long-on by Marsh for six more, he sprints to 81
full and very wide, Marsh can't reach it
a length ball outside off is thumped towards sweeper cover

this over began with a monster hit, and ends with another, people on the roof scurrying for safety as Marsh blasts a length ball from Hopes straight over the bowler's head and over the several tiers of stands and on to the roof, what a hit that was
another attempted sweep, off the pads towards the off side
goes to paddle it past short fine, an ambitious shot first ball, doesn't come off, that too against a slower one from Hopes
overpitched and outside off, drilled to long-off along the ground
the end of Hussey, he somehows gets plenty of power behind a whip off a full ball, not enough power to carry it past Sehwag at deep midwicket though
WHAT A SHOT from Hussey, the biggest hit of the day, that went on to the roof of the stadium, it was a length ball from Hopes, and Hussey murdered that one, massive, 106 metres
length ball, 141 kmh, Hussey powers it down the ground but can't beat Morkel at long-off, just a single
fullish ball outside off, carved behind backward point by Marsh
pace is down in this over, 127kmh, short of length, Marsh looks to bludgeon it but misses
length ball from Aaron, clubbed with a flat bat towards mid-in, misfield from Morkel gives away an extra run
poor ball from Aaron, bowled from round the wicket, full toss and very wide, Marsh gets a fine edge past the keeper for four
lovely hit from Hussey, placement wasn't the best though, Aaron bowled it on a length, and well outside off, slashed towards sweeper cover
reverts to the fullish length, and it works for Hopes, Hussey can get it only as far as mid-off for a single
slightly slower from Hopes, not full this time, Hussey's eye light up and he monsters that one into the crowd beyond long-on
Hopes keeps it full, Hussey can't get under it, looks to whip it to the leg side but can't get it away
short of length ball, Marsh wanted to send that to the square leg boundary, inside-edged towards short third, where the tall Morkel dives to keep Punjab to a single
full and on legstump, worked towards mid-on, good start to the over from Hopes
a low full toss on middle stump, eased towards wide long-on for a single
the final ball is a length one, Marsh smokes it past extra cover for four, brutal hit that
a periscopic hit from Hussey, the famed Agarkar bouncer takes Hussey by surprise, a vertical bat shot that sends the ball towards square leg
fullish and wide, eased towards long-off for one more
length ball on the pads, guided towards fine leg for a single
short and wide from Agarkar, lashed towards deep point

don't mess with the Ajit, he may go for plenty but he takes plenty of wickets as well, he bangs one in short, Karthik brings out the pull, gets a top edge which travels only as far as square leg, Agarkar gets his first
short of length ball, Marsh hammers that behind square leg for four to get to his fifty, Marsh keeps Punjab fighting, in what is increasingly looking like a losing cause
speared into the pads, that was sliding down leg side, Karthik can't get bat on it
slower ball on the pads, whipped behind backward square leg for a single
length ball just outside off, guided towards short third man for a single
worked to the leg side by Marsh this time
length ball served up Hopes, sledgehammered by Marsh for six over the bowler's head
ends with a 144.5kmh delivery, bowled from wide off the crease, angling into the batsman, who tucks it to the leg side for a single
full and wide outside off, Marsh reaches across and just about gets bat on it, can't get it past the keeper
this one is 135.6kmh, short of length and outside off, guided towards backward point
144.7 kmh from Aaron but that was a full toss outside leg stump, tickled past the keeper by Karthik for four

Aaron strikes, that's the end of Gilchrist, fired in from round the stumps, a short of length ball that angled in to the batsman, who was looking to smash that one to midwicket, he misses, middle stump is on the ground, Aaron roars in celebration
Aaron's back, his first ball is mistimed towards mid-off
overpitched on middle and off, worked wide of mid-on for a single, that is a superb over from Hopes
full and into the pads, Marsh wants to whip that toward deep backward square leg but doesn't connect
short of length ball, offcutter jumps up on the batsman, who defends it towards mid-off, Hopes falls over as he tries to stop the ball in his follow-through
eased towards long-off for a single
Hopes starts with a full ball on middle and leg, poked towards cover
and Ajit finishes his first over with 1-0-16-0, the last ball was on the pads, Gilchrist clubbed it towards midwicket but couldn't beat the fielder
a dot ball, relief for Agarkar, Gilchrist wanted to swipe that to point but missed out
all too easy for Gilchrist, Agarkar backers look away now, it was short and wide, Gilchrist doesn't bother with footwork as he chops it to the deep backward point boundary for a one-bounce four
oh dear, Ajit Agarkar is taking some punishment here, short ball on legstump, pulled powerfully for four more by Gilchrist
not the best of starts from Agarkar, he's been caned for another boundary, a length ball outside off, hammered over extra cover
starts with a full and wide one that is carved beyond backward point for a boundary
another boundary to round off the over, not power but placement this time, backs away from the stumps, and eases the ball behind backward point for four
Punjab aren't going to go down without a fight, Marsh leading the charge here, skates out nad lashes it over long-on, where Warner makes a valiant attempt to pluck it but its too high for him
slower ball from Nagar, given a touch of air, Marsh rocks back and carves that flatbatted past extra cover for four
fired in full and on legstump, goes for the booming drive, inside-edged on to the pads
on the pads, eased towards mid-on
shortish ball outside off, worked towards covers
length ball to finish the over, 145.6kmh, driven along the ground to long-off for a single
length ball on off, driven down to long-off by Gilchrist
145.7kmh this one, a much better ball as well, pitched up and just outside off, defended to the off
cramps Marsh for room, who dabs the ball towards backward point for a single
Aaron keeps it short, doesn't rise up much and it sits up for Marsh who slams it over long-on for six, 10 off the first two balls
starts with a 143kmh shortish ball, Marsh slugs it off the front foot past square leg for four
gets the edge once more, length ball on the pads, Gilchrist wants to work it to the leg side, but gets a leading edge towards cover
third man is proving very productive for Punjab, Gilchrist skips down the track and gets something of a to edge past slip for four
gets this one to shape away a touch from Gilchrist who is left groping for that outside off
pitched up and that has disappeared to the long-on boundary, power from Gilchrist
guided towards backward point
how did he get the power on that, it was slightly short from Irfan, Gilchrist leans back and thumps that over long-on
that kept a bit low outside off, batsman shouldered arms
length ball on legstump, carefully defended towards the bowler
short of length on legstump, edged towards the off side by Marsh
Marsh clears the front leg and murders that one past cover, he thrashes it for four
145kmh, and that squared up Marsh, he gets an edge on it, and that's past second slip for four, and it's a no-ball as well
that one ducks in to the batsman, who looks to drive but is beaten by that one, Morkel wonders what he needs to do to get a wicket
guided towards backward point, where Warner is around to field
and that is a maiden from Irfan, priceless when the asking rate starts at 11.5, the final ball of the over is pushed towards cover, take your hat off Irfan
way outside off, just within legal limits
the man who can do no wrong has made a fatal mistake, he opened himself up and wanted to hammer a short of length ball from Irfan, gets a top edge and the ball swirls towards point for a simple catch
seams into the batsman after it pitches around middle, Valthaty was looking to send that into orbit beyond midwicket, but is surprised by the movement
Valthaty isn't going to stand around defending, he looks to slash a back of length ball outside off, can't get bat on it
punched firmly towards mid-on, Warner moves to his left quickly to stop that
a beauty from Morkel to end the over, a length ball angling across Gilchrist who was looking to defend that down the ground but is beaten by the away movement
fuller from Morkel, and yet again Gilchrist is content to leave
a touch shorter, and there is no room for Gilchrist, he wants to play the cut but can't free his arms to get the power behind the shot
once again, Gilchrist is happy to leave the ball, 146kmh, length and just outside off
short of length ball outside off, left alone by Gilchrist
the six-fest continues at the Kotla, Gilchrist uses the pace of that one and helps it along to the deep backward square leg boundary
free-hit coming up, a length ball angling away that Gilchrist shouldered arms to
and the man who can do no wrong pummels another six to finish the over, powered over deep midwicket this time, a touch short from Irfan and Valthaty capitalises
massive from Valthaty this time, clobbered into the crowd over long-on for a big six, that's the first convincing runs from Punjab

another drop, Valthaty wanted to send that  out of the ground, he got plenty of height on the ball as he pulled it powerfully, but not the distance, Rao runs back from square leg and he should have taken that, but can't clasp it
pitched up this time from Irfan, getting the ball to move around in the air, punched back to the bowler
length ball on middle, worked towards midwicket by Valthaty
he starts with a ball that swings in extravagantly into the batsman, who keeps it out off the back foot
and again, Morkel has Gilchrist chasing a ball that is moving away from him, Gilchrist doesn't get bat on ball, winces in disappointment at the stroke he attempted
back of a length ball that nips in towards legstump, defended by Gilchrist
Gilchrist is having a tough time out there, little footwork as he looks to smash a slightly wide ball from Morkel, no contact
full and outside off, defended off the back foot towards cover
dropped, Naman Ojha dives across to take an edge from Gilchrist,  that was going straight to Sehwag, Ojha attempts a spectacular take but he can't latch on, that was 147kmh from Morkel
length ball to start from Morkel, driven to the off side by Gilchrist
